facts.fact: Kiamling 断定这片黑暗既不是十八层地狱中的任何一层，也不是 Archie 事先给她讲过的妖精之地，怀疑两界之间的路本身出了问题。
facts.anchor: Kiamling did not recognise it as any of the eighteen levels of hell, nor the land of fae that Archie had prepared her for.

facts.fact: 黑暗中浮出成群穿中式衣衫的高大身影，把 Kiamling 四面围住，却全部背对着她，僵硬如柱。
facts.anchor: Tall figures in Chinese clothing stood on all sides of her, rigid as immovable pillars. All of them, in every direction, had their backs turned to her.

facts.fact: Kiamling 双手发抖地摸自己的脸，狂乱地来回移动，却什么也摸不到——她的脸也变成了没有五官的光滑一片。
facts.anchor: Kiamling’s hands shook as she brought them up to her own face. She moved them frantically, but she could not feel anything.

facts.fact: 腰间一阵猛拽把 Kiamling 拽醒，她脸上同时奇痒；一只人脸黑黄斑蝉在她旁边跺着六只脚叫骂。
facts.anchor: An insistent tug on her waist woke Kiamling up, along with the fierce itching on her face.

facts.fact: Kiamling 发现妖精们围圈跳舞的那座“土丘”正随深睡一呼一吸地起伏，确认自己的直觉没错：下面埋着人。
facts.anchor: The mound moved. Up and down, up and down in deep slumber. Her instinct was correct.

facts.fact: Kiamling 徒手挖开松土，露出 Ng Choy 的脸，又推倒蘑菇小屋、扯断捆住他双腿的藤蔓，把他上半身解放出来。
facts.anchor: Kiamling dug still, finding Ng Choy’s face under a layer of loose soil. She toppled over the toadstool houses to free his upper limbs, tearing vines from where his legs had been bound together.

facts.fact: Kiamling 扑到律师身上，把红线系到他腰带上，试图拦腰把他抱起来拖走，却已没有真气可借，只剩蛮力。
facts.anchor: “No!” She threw herself on top of the barrister, attaching the red string to his belt, and tried to heft him around the waist.

facts.fact: Kiamling 摸黑抓了一把朝妖精撒去，虫群嘶叫着后退，她这才发现自己摸错了袋子——撒出去的是糯米而不是盐。
facts.anchor: The winged demons flew backwards with a hiss, giving her space to look, to breathe, to realise she had reached into the wrong pouch entirely. She had thrown glutinous rice.

facts.fact: 妖精们聚到 Kiamling 撒下的盐米防线旁齐扇翅膀，震得空气发颤，把盐米粒一点点吹向前、破了她的护线。
facts.anchor: They had amassed by the barriers she had scattered, fluttering their wings so that the air thrummed. The salt and rice grains rolled forward.

facts.fact: Kiamling 手脚并用把 Ng Choy 当米袋一样缠住，抱着他顺坡滚向雾墙。
facts.anchor: She wrapped her arms and legs around Ng Choy as if he were a sack of rice and rolled on the ground.

facts.fact: Kiamling 本能挥出右勾拳，打中一个又大又实的东西；对方闷哼一声，用粤语咒骂她的祖宗。
facts.anchor: She instinctively jabbed out with a right hook, surprised when she hit something big and solid. Someone groaned and cursed her ancestors in Cantonese.

facts.fact: Archie 跪到 Kiamling 身边，她才知道自己进环时还是夜里，如今已过了一个多星期。
facts.anchor: Her shoulders sagged with relief as the Englishman knelt beside her. “It’s been over a week.”

facts.fact: 海哥（Hoi gor）告诉 Kiamling，那头兽在她失踪那晚伤了两个人，又斜眼看向 Archie，说这个鬼佬当时跑了。
facts.anchor: “It mauled two people the night you went missing.” Hoi gor side-eyed Archie. “The gweilo ran away.”

facts.fact: 海哥摊开手，递出三枚六便士银币，手上满是像被线反复缠绕留下的红痕。
facts.anchor: He held out three silver sixpences. His hands were stained with red lines, as if he had wound the threads round and round them.

facts.fact: Kiamling 在妖精环边插上三炷香，又把三枚银币和 Hoi gor 替她弄来的一个馒头摆到盘子里作供。
facts.anchor: She lit three joss sticks and pushed them into the ground by the fae ring. Next to them, on a plate, she placed the three silver pieces and a mantau Hoi gor had procured for her.

facts.fact: 为满足妖精“要一段好记忆”的要求，Kiamling 献出自己珍视的童年记忆——龙须糖的味道：细得能吸进鼻子的白糖丝与中心温热的花生脆。
facts.anchor: The taste of dragon-beard candy. Wisps of white sugar so fine she could inhale them. The warming crunch of peanuts at the centre.

facts.fact: 那段记忆随即消失，Kiamling 再回想时只剩一片灰雾，以及说不清的失落。
facts.anchor: Gone. A grey fog in its place when she tried to recall it. A feeling of loss that she could not define.

facts.fact: 妖精散去后，Kiamling 瞥见水沟里爬过一只黑虫，一脚踩下去，虫壳在脚下咔嚓碎开。
facts.anchor: Out of the corner of her eye, she saw a black bug skittering in the gutter. She stamped on it, the shell crunching under her foot with a satisfying crack.
